title: Resolving the remaining short-document assessments
objective: Revisit the 56 unresolved assessments in the latest 20 short responses; prioritise recoverable primary evidence and independently re-review proposed resolutions.
rules: Read actual original context; recorded proposition remains the target. A narrower supported fragment does not silently resolve a stronger compound.
Retain reasonable author interpretations. Reconsider excessively strong evidence demands, but distinguish that methodological change from new evidence.
Find targeted primary evidence outside author citations, exact dates/versions, definitions, methods and denominators. Document actual passages checked and access limits.
Initial resolution proposals freeze before scheduled peer reads; peer repeats primary checks and author context and reviews retained uncertainties as well as proposed changes. Root adjudicates.
No new finding solely from missing evidence, policy disagreement or prediction. No author contact, purchasing database access, human specialist confirmation or intent inference.
Do not alter prior completed ledgers, protocols, adjudications, source notes or review records. Produce a linked follow-up overlay.
New background bytes in system temp only, shared when useful, removed after final review. Preserve concise authored check notes, source identities, URLs, dates, locators and observed hashes.
No new reading unit for rechecking. No artificial duration or token budget is imposed.
completion_gates: All 56 assigned cases have an explicit disposition or scoped no-further-check rationale
Every proposed resolution independently reviewed against original context and new evidence
All challenges adjudicated and potential new findings separately reviewed
Historical baselines preserved; report and appropriate validation complete
limits: This is a follow-up to 56 recorded assessments, not an exhaustive check of every assertion or the separate 38 main unresolved leads.
Support is scoped; unresolved remains appropriate when primary evidence cannot settle the actual claim.
The 56 cases occur in 16 existing short originals / 53 physical pages. This is a claim follow-up, not a new exhaustive 20-document batch or additional reading units.
Independent AI cross-review and root adjudication; no author contact or human specialist confirmation.
